про: Одне визначення запису речі (наряд Запис-речі-новий-вид; корінь Річ-запис-речі, рішення менеджера 21.11 і 26.11). Ключ мітки — поле ПОЛЯ_РЕЧІ ядра (поняття.py) або «слот»; питання — мова промпту запису (англійська); значення — коди названого реєстру; де — слоти ядра, де мітка застосовна (нема — усі); джерела — дозволені за порядком довіри; лише_зі_слів — значення, яке дає лише крамниця (фото відсутності не доводить); читачі — пул, запит чи картка (правила знань, що читають поле, дає ядро/дані/правила.json, ключ «річ»). Тепло шару модель не оцінює: «виведено» каже, з чого його рахує код. Колір — коди словника відтінків (`ядро/дані/відтінки.json`) з частками й принтом, лише з фото; слово крамниці кольору не дає — лише інтервал вікна коду кольору (наряд Запис-речі-колір-мітка). Мітка без читача — помилка (тест Ч2).

опис.питання: Describe in Ukrainian, in your own words, everything you can see or read about this item that a stylist would need: print or motif and its scale, embroidery, lace, trims and decoration and where they sit, texture, construction of a multi-part item, fastening, visible edges, details. Name a conflict between the photo and the shop's words. Two to five sentences, no instructions to anyone, no guesses about what is not shown.
читачі: запит: стилістка й суддя-модель читають опис поруч із номером речі

слот.питання: Which single place on the body does this item occupy in an outfit? Jackets, blazers and cardigans take outerwear; hair accessories take hair, separate from headwear; pendants and necklaces share one place; ties and detachable collars take the scarf place; a jumpsuit takes the full-body dress place. Use unknown for a part of another item with no place of its own.

тип.питання: What kind of item is it?
читачі: пул: відмова за типом і названа нею річ

крій.питання: What cut does the item itself show: where it fits close and where it gives volume? Straight is not A-line.

довжина.питання: Where does the hem end on the body, as seen on a full-length photo or stated by the shop?

тканина.питання: What is the visible outer layer made of? For shoes and bags this is the upper material. A photo shows texture, not fibre content.

візерунок.питання: Is there a printed or woven pattern, and which family? A plain base with embroidery or lace is solid: embroidery and lace go to the description only.
читачі: пул: смілива річ і відмова за візерунком

колір.питання: Which colours does the item itself show? Every item gets this label, jewellery and accessories included. Look at every photo of the gallery; judge the item's own surface in good light, not the background, the skin, other garments, shadows or glare. Name each colour by the closest code of the colour list below (ISCC-NBS colour names): the main colour first, then up to three more, each with its share of the item's visible surface (shares add up to 1); never more than four codes, and only codes from the list, never a made-up one. "принт": true when the colours form a printed or woven pattern, false for a solid item or colour blocks. Lightness and saturation: take them from the item's mid-tones, not from highlights or shadows — vivid, brilliant and strong are clear saturated colours, deep is saturated and dark, moderate is medium, grayish and pale are muted; compare the neighbouring codes of the same hue before choosing. A print or pattern: the main colour is its ground, the colour that covers most of the item, and up to three motif colours follow with their shares; fold smaller motif colours into the nearest named one, a busy print is still answered, not unknown. Several materials (feathers, beads, stones, fabric, metal): shares by the visible area of each. Metals: yellow gold — an orange_yellow code (strong or moderate, deep when dark); rose gold — moderate_yellowish_pink, grayish_yellowish_pink or light_reddish_brown (the light_ and pale_ pinks are too pale for it), never an orange_yellow or a yellow; silver and steel — light_gray or medium_gray; black stays black when glossy. Common names: fuchsia and hot magenta pink — vivid or strong purplish_red or purplish_pink; raspberry and berry — strong or moderate purplish_red; burgundy and wine-red — very_dark_red, dark_red or very_deep_red, a purplish_red only when it clearly leans to purple; dusty pink — grayish_pink or grayish_purplish_pink; pinkish taupe — light_grayish_reddish_brown or grayish_red; teal and petrol — greenish_blue; turquoise — brilliant or vivid greenish_blue, bluish_green; camel — light or moderate yellowish_brown; taupe — light_brownish_gray, grayish_yellowish_brown; ivory and cream — yellowish_white; cool white pearls and white fabric — white. The shop's colour word is not an answer: answer from the photos only. Torn between two neighbouring codes for the main colour: uncertain with both codes as bounds. The photos do not show the item's colour: unknown.
читачі: пул: колір рядка кандидата (color, hex, family, L) — з ділянки основного коду, решта кодів і принт — у джерелі

ошатність.питання: Which formality step does the shop state or the item visibly prove (sequins, satin evening cut, sportswear details)? If neither, unknown: do not default to a middle step.

сезон_тканини.питання: For which weather bands does the shop say the item is meant, or does the item visibly prove it (fur, padding, open mesh)? If neither, unknown. Jewellery gets no season.

каблук.питання: Heel height in centimetres: a number from the shop's words; 0 when there is no separate heel. From a photo only a range: answer uncertain with bounds. A platform is not heel height.

підошва.питання: What sole does the pair have: its material from the shop's words, or a smooth versus lug (deep tread) outsole visible on the photo of the sole?

водостійкість.питання: Does the shop say whether the item is waterproof or water-repellent (membrane, treated)? yes: the shop says it is; no: the shop says it is not. If the shop says nothing about water, unknown: silence is not no. Only the shop's words count: a photo does not prove it.

утеплення.питання: Is the item insulated? From the shop's words: none: the shop says unlined, no lining or no insulation; light: the shop names a thin warming lining or padding (flannel, thin fleece, thin padding for autumn or spring); warm: the shop names thick padding, down, fur or sheepskin lining, or says it is for winter. From the photo only when insulation is plainly visible: fur or shearling at the opening, collar or cuff, or a quilted padded shell; then light for thin quilting, warm for fur or a thick puffer. The photo never gives none. A closed shoe or a coat without such words or signs is unknown: silence is not none.

метал.питання: Which metal does the shop name for the jewellery? A golden colour does not prove gold.

тепло_шару.таблиця_джерело: джерела нема: параметр ядра, виміряти (як М1 §3 «Числа без джерела»); синтетика без утеплення тепла не визначає
